messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — Sirocco-30B landed in model-repo. Need a quick prioritization and bring-up plan for onboarding + quant experiments. TL;DR: target p95 <120ms hosted, aim for int8 quant if quality holds. @Alex @Devon can you take this this week?
Alex Rivera: On it. I'll run a baseline perf vs Falcon-40B-r2 on g5x2. Quick bench command I use:
```
./bench -m sirocco-30b -b 8 -seq 1024 --gpu g5x2
```
Devon Patel: I'll wire up the eval jobs. Need prod prompt set (eval-A) + hallucination/regression checks. Plan: run baseline eval -> PTQ -> QAT if PTQ regresses. @Li can you help with qat infra?
Li Wang: Yep. I'll prep a qconfig and a small QAT job. Example QAT run:
```
train --model sirocco-30b --qat --epochs 3 --lr 2e-5 --eval-set eval-A
```
Expectation: PTQ may be fine; QAT if we need to recover ~1-3% quality. I'll capture logits/delta metrics for drift analysis.
deploy-bot: bench job #842 queued by Alex (g5x2).
Alex Rivera: Quick smoke results from bench #842 (fp16): p95=140ms, tokens/s=220. For reference Falcon-40b fp16 p95=200ms on same infra. So Sirocco is faster but still above our hosted p95 target. FP16->int8 should give ~1.5-1.8x speedup in tokens/s.
Maya Chen: Good data — prioritization criteria: score high if quant gives >30% cost reduction w/o >3% eval degradation or hallucination +5%. Otherwise defer. Quick decision poll: +1 prioritize now, -1 defer.
Devon Patel: Added ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-3214 with checklist: bench -> eval -> PTQ -> QAT if needed -> monitoring hooks -> rollout canary. Rollout rollback criteria in ticket.
Li Wang: I'll push qconfigs to: https://git.redwood.ai/models/sirocco/qconfigs and start small QAT run tonight. Will report perf + eval deltas.
Alex Rivera: I'll iterate on kernel flags/batching. Trying batch_size=4/8/16 sweep. Also will test continuous-batching config: `CBATCH=enabled max_batch=32`.
Maya Chen: Assigning owners: Alex (perf + rollout), Devon (eval + regression gating), Li (quant + QAT). Sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. If any blockers post here. :thumbsup:
